subject: Coordinating 30m intro with your panel — availability options

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Coordinating 30m intro with your panel — availability options

Hi Sana — thanks again for the call today, really helpful to learn about MeshHealth's latency-sensitive triage workflow and the token-volume seasonality you're expecting.

Quick recap and next step: we'd like to schedule a 30‑minute product intro that includes 2 technical stakeholders from your side so we can walk through:
- How Redwood handles multi-tenant inference with dedicated pools
- Batching & KV cache examples for short, bursty traffic
- A short Q&A on security controls (SOC2 / audit logs)

Can you and the team pick one of these windows (all in PT)?
1) Tue Nov 17 — 10:00–10:30 (PT)
2) Wed Nov 18 — 14:00–14:30 (PT)
3) Thu Nov 19 — 09:00–09:30 (PT)

Please let me know which you prefer and who else from your side should join (we'll include a Solutions Engineer for the technical portion). Attached is a short 6‑slide deck that gives context on the demo so attendees know what to expect.

If none of those work, send 2 windows that do and we'll adapt.

Thanks — look forward to lining this up.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien | Account Executive

I don't think we need the security deep-dive in this first 30m — saving that for a follow-up with our security lead.
